ios.desc:
• ABOUT UBIQ •
Ubiq is a spatial network. It brings your photos, videos and identity to life in a shared 3D world.
We didn't evolve 3D brains to scroll down 2D feeds forever.

• HOW IT WORKS •
Ubiq opens an immersive 3D map of the real world filled with photos and videos posted by your friends and schoolmates. Instead of scrolling through a feed, you explore a shared 3D world to see what friends and classmates were doing in different places. It’s like flying through the real world - and you’re always in control of what you see.

• WHAT MAKES UBIQ DIFFERENT •

3D CONNECTION
People use Ubiq to share photos & videos directly into the 3D world, tag friends, compare places they’ve been to and just have fun staying up on what friends and classmates are doing.
Other apps bury your life in a feed or delete your story by morning. On Ubiq, your world builds over time and becomes richer with every post on a random Tuesday.

SPATIAL STORIES
Ubiq transforms ordinary photos and videos into beautiful, immersive cinematics you can move through, anchored to the real places where they happened.
Zoom in from the sky, through the wall, to dinner with friends. Fly through your big night out with a cinematic camera that moves between photos and videos you snapped at each stop.

DIGITAL DIARY
Showcase all the places you’ve ever visited through auto-generated dashboards made with zero effort and full privacy controls.
Discover your shared history with friends, classmates, and people around you.

• TL;DR •
No influencers. No ads. No feeds.
We’re building a future where our digital interactions look and feel as natural as the real world.
